DOLAT CAPITAL
Name: Yash Shroff
Branch: IT
ID : 201080040
Year : 2023
CTC : 21 Lakhs (Thoda bada chada ke hai )
Base 12L + Variable pay + ( retention bonus over 5 years spread.)

1. FIRST ROUND (Online test):
●2 Sections
Each section had 2 coding questions
Q1.
You are given an integer array A and an integer K ,
Remove the minimum number of elements such that the frequency of
each element is divisible by k.
Return the min number of elements removed.
Q2.
Implement a billing system for a Parking lot of Commercial building.
This had a lot of conditions and accordingly was to implemented.
Q3.
The name was something punished students ,
There are N students numbered from 1 to N who visited a museum.
They entered in the order A1, A2, .., AN and exited in the order B1,
B2,..BN. If the ith student overtook the jth student, then the ith student
will be punished. Any student can be punished at most once
Return the count of punished students.
Q4.
An integer N is given ,
P is all prime numbers less than N
Q is all fibonacci numbers less than N
Find number of elements is in Q Union P
(14 STUDENTS GOT SELECTED IN THIS ROUND.)

2. SECOND ROUND →Tech round (OFFLINE ROUND AT DOLAT )(1 hour 40 mins)
I was interviewed by 2 Senior Employees of DOLAT Capital at their office.
●
The Interview will be completely on Cpp and OOPs and DSA
Avoid using Standard template libraries (STL) in codes
1.
Introduce Yourself ?Followed by how would I rate myself on OOPs & DSA
I replied 6.5 to each on a scale of 1 to 10.
The interview began with a few starter C++ and OOPs questions
1.
Pillars of OOPs. Explain all (Encapsulation, Abstraction, Polymorphism, Inheritance)
2.
Implement inheritance with code and example
(Access specifiers) (Code it on paper)
3.
Combined questions on Inheritance,Types of Inheritance
a.
Difference between public, private and protected
i.
What happens when in parent class access specifier are x/y/z and
Access specifiers of child class are x/y/z.
(x/y/z corresponds to public , protected,private).
→Diamond problem , scope resolution operator.
4.
Polymorphism and its types (Explain each and Code on paper )
1.
Talking about parameters in function overloading , what happens if
Parameter is default.
(If two functions , one with two param and one with three param is called,
But a function call is made with two param and third as default , then what will happen , will
func with two param be called or func with three param , or compiler error)
This was a tricky question (read about how default para works with operator overloading).
→Imp questions on virtual keyword
Which func will get called when?
→What happens when base class pointer points to child class
→What happens when child class pointer points to base class
(UPCASTING AND DOWNCASTING)

5.
Basic questions on many more operators like “->”, “;”, “::”, “*”, “&”
6.
Getters setters
7.
Constructors , types of constructors
a.
Default, parameterised , Copy
b.
Use of delete keyword
Use of this keyword
●
Inheritance with constructors :
What happens when Child class has parameterised constructor and base class has
a default constructor , Then which all constructors get called child obj is created ?,
How to initialise parent if parent has parameterised constructor via child?
I told them how inheritance causes parent class constructor to be called before child
class with example
8.Difference between Static and Dynamic Allocation of objects
9.Keywords - new, malloc, static, void, this
DSA
1.
Build a class of LinkedList
2.
What are diff types of data structures?
3.
Explain stack and queue,
Why stack /queue are used , if arrays can be used?
4.
Given a singly LinkedList and a pointer to a node (which is to be deleted)
And only that is given , how would you delete it?
Basically no head pointer was given so yeah.
See this question online and you will find it easily. Once I solved it , I told them that it
is possible to do so in all cases except if the node is the last node.
Then they told me to solve it if the pointer was of last node only , we had some
discussion here but couldn't really get to any conclusion.
5.
Given a sorted array 1, 5, 7, 10, 11 -> return the indices of two numbers that add up
to a given target. Example if target = 8 return 0, 2
First approach is using two nested loops .
Then I gave them two pointer approach , it was not clear so I was asked to code it on
paper.
Then they wanted one more solution so i gave hash map one , they denied it ,
Then I gave them a binary search solution , which again I was asked to code down
on the paper.
I was asked to explain Time complexity in detail.
6.
All ques time complexity I had explained first hand , linked one they had asked me
upfront and I had told them the correct ans.

7.
We were running short of time so had a small convo with them , told them I had my
internship just finished a day before the interview , they asked me what I had
prepared , then I told them I revised concepts of trees , recursion, DP.
8.
They asked me what all you saw in Dp, I told them just visited a few famous
problems , Coin change , knapsack etc. Told them how recursion then memoization
top down works.
I was able to answer most questions except a question on malloc and Hash Maps
3. HR Round (15 mins)
1.
Checked Resume
2.
Saw Projects and asked a few things
3.
Plans for masters ,Family members
4.
Why DOLAT?
5.
C++ OR Python
6.
Why not the current internship company’s PPO?
I asked a few questions about the company , how work is assigned , and then my feedback.
